newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy govt mulls Eni sell-off bond - report.
newsitem.headline: Italy govt mulls Eni sell-off bond - report.

text.p: Italy is considering bringing forward the sale of a third tranche of stock in energy group Eni and placing the shares by means of a privatisation bond, newspaper Corriere della Sera said on Saturday.

Treasury Minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi said recently that the third Eni tranche would be sold off this autumn, but in an unsourced article, Corriere said the government was considering holding the sale "in the very near future".
It said the Treasury was pondering issuing bonds convertable into Eni stock. Ciampi used the same mechanism last year for the successful sale of shares in insurance group INA.

The Treasury holds just under 70 percent of Eni and is not expected to relinquish its majority stake in any third tranche offering. The second tranche placement, executed through a regular public offering, was completed October.
